settings.heading: Toys that grow little minds
settings.body: We hand-pick every toy for play value, not just packaging — things that build curiosity, patience and giggles. If we wouldn't give it to our own kids, it's not on the shelf.

settings.heading: Learning that feels like play
settings.body: STEM kits, puzzles and craft sets that sneak a little learning into every giggle. Sorted by age and skill, so it's easy to find the perfect next challenge.

settings.heading: Play value comes first
settings.body: Before a toy makes the shelf, we ask one question: will a child come back to it? We look for open-ended play, sturdy build and real imagination — not just a shiny box.

settings.heading: Safe hands, happy play
settings.body: Every product is age-graded and independently safety-tested. Non-toxic materials, no sharp edges, and clear age guidance on every listing so you can shop with total confidence.

settings.heading: Here before the big day
settings.body: Order by 9pm on a weekday for next-day delivery, fully tracked. Need it gift-wrapped? Add a wrap at checkout and we'll send it ready to give.

blocks.question: How do I know a toy is right for my child's age?
blocks.answer: Every product lists a recommended age range and skill focus. When in doubt, use the shop-by-age filter or message us — we're happy to help you pick.

blocks.question: Are your toys safety-tested?
blocks.answer: Yes. Everything we sell is independently safety-tested and made from non-toxic materials, with clear age guidance and any small-parts warnings on the listing.

blocks.question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
blocks.answer: We do. Add gift wrap at checkout and we'll wrap your order and include a message card — ready to hand straight over.

blocks.question: How fast is delivery?
blocks.answer: Order by 9pm on a weekday for next-day delivery, fully tracked. Standard delivery is free over your store's threshold.

blocks.question: What if my child doesn't love it?
blocks.answer: Return any unopened toy within 30 days for a full refund. If something arrives faulty, we'll replace it and cover the postage.
